summary: Iteration 5 RETEST of two iter-4 fixes. (1) Backend RBAC on PUT /api/admin/settings — VERIFIED FIXED after one additional 1-line patch (see below). (2) Frontend /admin/home infinite spinner — VERIFIED FIXED: page now loads KPIs/charts on first paint, all 4 quick actions navigate, error+retry UI is wired. Full backend regression: 58 passed / 1 skipped. End-to-end user-side KYC submission and admin Users modal Quick Actions also re-validated.

minor.issue: AdminUserUpdate Pydantic model was missing `admin_role` field, so {role:'admin', admin_role:'manager'} silently dropped admin_role and the user was promoted to admin with admin_role=None — which `require_admin_role` (server.py:145) defaults to super_admin, bypassing the new RBAC. Fixed in this iteration by adding `admin_role: Optional[str] = None` to AdminUserUpdate (server.py:618). Without this fix, the iter-4 require_admin_role wire-up appeared to silently regress.

issues: Carry-over: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` warning still in expo logs. Cosmetic only.

react_native_issues.issue: Still 15.15.4 vs Expo expected 15.12.1 — non-blocking; charts on /admin/home render correctly.

action_items: [NONE-CRITICAL] Both reported iter-4 bugs are now fixed and verified. The 1-line model-field patch in this iteration is the only code change made by the testing agent.
[LOW] Consider adding `extra='forbid'` (Pydantic) to AdminUserUpdate so future field-mismatches fail fast instead of silently dropping.

[LOW] In `require_admin_role` (server.py:145), defaulting missing admin_role to 'super_admin' is generous — the seed admin already has admin_role='super_admin' set, so the legacy fallback can be removed and replaced with explicit 403 when admin_role is null. Defense-in-depth.
[MEDIUM] `npx expo install react-native-svg` to align package version (15.12.1).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:614 AdminUserUpdate omitted admin_role — a quietly destructive bug because Pydantic v2 ignores unknown fields by default. Now fixed.
server.py:145 `sub = admin.get('admin_role') or 'super_admin'` — using `or` instead of `is None` makes empty-string also default to super_admin. Low-risk but worth tightening.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py — Added `admin_role: Optional[str] = None` field to AdminUserUpdate Pydantic model (line ~616) so PATCH /admin/users/{id} can promote/demote sub-roles. rca_of_issue: Iter-4 bug RCA confirmation — Backend: server.py:702 was correctly updated to Depends(require_admin_role('super_admin')), but the companion AdminUserUpdate Pydantic model (server.py:614) did not allow the admin_role field, so promoting via PATCH was a no-op and the test couldn't actually create a manager. Fix: add `admin_role: Optional[str] = None` to AdminUserUpdate. Frontend: admin/home.tsx now (a) gates initial load on `if (!user) return` for auth hydration, (b) tracks an `error` state and (c) renders an explicit Error UI with `home-retry` button instead of a permanent spinner — verified visually.
